summary_md: Adds the synchronous OTLP exporter behind the existing exporter trait and wires it into daemon startup. Export failures are logged with their typed error and never block message delivery.
deliverables: `SyncOtlpExporter` implements `Exporter` in `crates/otel/src/sync.rs`, with unit tests for success, timeout and endpoint-refused.
Daemon startup selects the exporter from `[otel] mode`; an unknown mode is a typed config error.
